name: Ritz Paris
tagline: One hundred and forty-two rooms and suites at 15 Place Vendôme, open since 1898.
description:
The Ritz Paris is a hotel of 142 rooms and suites at 15 Place Vendôme, in the first arrondissement. César Ritz opened it on 1 June 1898 as the first hotel to bear his name, and it keeps a garden, a pool, a Michelin-starred restaurant and 16 named Prestige Suites.

The hotel stands on the royal square, a short walk from the Opéra Garnier and the Louvre. Coco Chanel, Ernest Hemingway and Marcel Proust were among its guests, and several of the suites carry their names. The Grand Jardin lies at the centre of the house, with the Espadon restaurant across from it.

The 142 rooms and suites are each different. The Superior Room measures 35 square metres and the Grand Deluxe Room 55. The Prestige Suites include the Suite Ernest Hemingway at 79 square metres over the Grand Jardin, the Suite Opéra at 87 square metres, and the Suite Mansart at 85 square metres, with a terrace and a view of the Eiffel Tower. The Suite Vendôme covers 163 square metres, L'Appartement Ritz takes the whole seventh floor at 169 square metres, and the Suite F. Scott Fitzgerald has two bedrooms and a hammam over 185 square metres. The Suite Coco Chanel measures 188 square metres, and the Suite Impériale, at 218 square metres, has a private dining room and a view of Place Vendôme.

Espadon holds a Michelin star under Eugénie Béziat and serves dinner from Tuesday to Saturday. The Bar Vendôme is open every day from 9 am to midnight, with a terrace, and the Ritz Bar is run by Romain de Courcy. Tea is served in the Salon Proust by the head pastry chef Olivier Lainé, and breakfast in the Salon Marie-Louise. The hotel also has the Ecole Ritz Escoffier for cooking courses.

The Ritz Club & Spa, at 17 Place Vendôme, has an indoor pool, three fitness rooms and treatment rooms, and a hair salon by David Mallett. Treatments are given every day from 9 am to 8 pm, and the hotel's fitness centre is open to guests at all hours.

The house suits those who want a historic address on Place Vendôme, with the Louvre and the Opéra within walking distance.
